conflict-direct.wav.title: Version one: direct wording, steady pace
conflict-direct.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.chapter: Version one: direct wording, steady pace
turns.text: We cannot finish the review by Friday with the packet arriving Thursday. Can we move the deadline to Tuesday?

conflict-indirect.wav.title: Version two: tentative wording
conflict-indirect.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: I wonder whether Friday gives us enough review time. The packet arrives Thursday. Would Tuesday be possible?

stay-opening.wav.title: Listen to the practice opening
stay-opening.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Before we begin, let us review who can see the notes and how they will be used. I cannot promise more privacy than this process provides. If speaking with me makes this harder, we can discuss another appropriate interviewer. What part of the work has made staying harder?

interpreter-before.wav.title: Before the appointment
interpreter-before.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Worker to interpreter: We will discuss the appointment notice and the next step. Here are the terms used on the form. We have allowed time for each turn.

interpreter-turn.wav.title: During the conversation
interpreter-turn.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Worker, addressing the person: What would you like us to understand about this appointment? The worker stops speaking while the interpreter conveys the question and the person responds.

interpreter-check.wav.title: Before leaving
interpreter-check.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Worker: To check that I explained it clearly, how will this next step fit into your week? What should we clarify?

packet-drift.wav.title: The discussion drifts
packet-drift.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Colleague: Some people here just do not understand inclusion. Another colleague starts defending their awareness.

packet-redirect.wav.title: The chair redirects
packet-redirect.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Chair: Let us return to the packet. It arrived at the start of the meeting. Two people asked for reading time. What can we change about when it goes out?

packet-next-step.wav.title: The team records the next step
packet-next-step.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.chapter: The team records the next step
turns.text: Chair: Who can send the next draft early enough for review? Let us agree the arrangement and check on Friday whether people had usable preparation time.

pace-today.wav.title: Start with today
pace-today.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Person: A long meeting will not work for me today. Worker: Here are our previous notes. What still fits, and what is most useful to discuss today?

pace-topic.wav.title: Narrow the conversation
pace-topic.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.text: Person: I want to settle the transport question. Worker: Let us focus on that and leave the other topics for an agreed next conversation.

pace-next-step.wav.title: Put the next step in a usable form
pace-next-step.wav.summary: Listen to the scene, then consider what you might say next.

turns.speaker: geffen
turns.chapter: Put the next step in a usable form
turns.text: Next-step card: Transport question — worker will check the available option; person prefers a written response; follow-up time to be agreed together.
